doc.title: Feature Improvement Proposals
doc.snippet: Story 15.3: Video Length Optimization - biết video length tối ưu để maximize engagement. ACs: Analyze performance by video length, recommend optimal length per format, compare với niche benchmarks.

doc.title: Story 13.4: Watch Time Analytics
doc.snippet: Watch time analytics: total watch time, average view duration, completion rate. Provides foundation data for length optimization analysis.

doc.title: Story 15.2: Retention Curve Analysis
doc.snippet: Retention curve analysis với drop-off detection. Complements length optimization by showing where viewers drop off.

artifact.reason: Foundation service for watch time data. DURATION_ESTIMATES constant defines estimated durations per content type. getWatchTimeMetrics() provides base data for length analysis.
Content metadata service. ContentMetadata interface includes contentType. Used to categorize videos by format for length analysis.
Daily metrics service. DailyMetricData includes videoViews, reactions, comments, shares - needed for calculating engagement rate per length range.
Reference pattern for format-specific analysis. Shows how to handle different content formats with format-specific recommendations.
Reference for format selector UI. Shows tabbed interface for different content formats.
